name: Christine Daae
source:
Member of the opera's chorus. Born in Sweden.

She became the foster child of Professor Valerius and his wife after her father, a music teacher, passed away. She studied at the Paris Conservatory for 3 years, but only attained average grades.

While her singing voice is said to be exquisite, she has been criticized for her poor acting skills. She has been trying hard to improve them. 

Slight nearsighted, her vision is rather poor.
